subject: english
stem:
Ben did not win the race, yet he cut two minutes from his best time.
Which answer is supported by the full text?
options: Losing always matters more than improvement
Ben made personal progress even without winning

optionRationales.reason: Losing always matters more than improvement：作者以 yet 強調 improvement。
Ben became two minutes slower：cut two minutes 表更快。
Ben made personal progress even without winning：yet 後的個人進步是正面重點。
Ben did not win：只保留轉折前比賽名次。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「轉折標記後的修正、限制或作者真正採納的立場」可推出 Ben made personal progress even without winning；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Ben made personal progress even without winning 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
